```{r load-area-data}
# --- Area datasets by size category ---
area_data_joined <- readRDS("Data/area_data.rds")
area_t1d         <- readRDS("Data/area_data_t1d.rds")

area_singlets      <- readRDS("Data/area_data_singlets.rds")
area_singlets_t1d  <- readRDS("Data/area_data_singlets_t1d.rds")
area_endobs        <- readRDS("Data/area_data_endobs.rds")
area_endobs_t1d    <- readRDS("Data/area_data_endobs_t1d.rds")
area_islets        <- readRDS("Data/area_data_islets.rds")
area_islets_t1d    <- readRDS("Data/area_data_islets_t1d.rds")

# --- Area combined datasets (logIC zeroed for singletons, per cell type) ---
beta_combined      <- readRDS("Data/area_data_beta_combined.rds")
beta_combined_t1d  <- readRDS("Data/area_data_beta_combined_t1d.rds")
alpha_combined     <- readRDS("Data/area_data_alpha_combined.rds")
alpha_combined_t1d <- readRDS("Data/area_data_alpha_combined_t1d.rds")
delta_combined     <- readRDS("Data/area_data_delta_combined.rds")
delta_combined_t1d <- readRDS("Data/area_data_delta_combined_t1d.rds")
pp_combined        <- readRDS("Data/area_data_pp_combined.rds")
pp_combined_t1d    <- readRDS("Data/area_data_pp_combined_t1d.rds")
```

```{r exploratory}
summary(beta_combined_model)
summary(alpha_combined_model)

# These don't adjust for islet size — does Diagnosis appear?
emmeans(area_alpha_1cell,  ~ Diagnosis, data = area_singlets)
emmeans(area_alpha_2to14,  ~ Diagnosis, data = area_endobs)

# This does adjust for islet size — does Diagnosis disappear?
emmeans(area_alpha_15plus, ~ Diagnosis, data = area_islets)

alpha_combined <- alpha_combined %>%
  mutate(object_type = factor(case_when(
    Islet.Cells == 1 ~ "Singlets",
    Islet.Cells >= 2 & Islet.Cells <= 14 ~ "SEOs",
    Islet.Cells >= 15 ~ "Islets"),
    levels = c("Singlets", "SEOs", "Islets")))

emmeans(alpha_combined_model, pairwise ~ Diagnosis | object_type,
        data = alpha_combined, adjust = "none", reverse = TRUE)

beta_combined <- beta_combined %>%
  mutate(object_type = factor(case_when(
    Islet.Cells == 1 ~ "Singlets",
    Islet.Cells >= 2 & Islet.Cells <= 14 ~ "SEOs",
    Islet.Cells >= 15 ~ "Islets"),
    levels = c("Singlets", "SEOs", "Islets")))

emmeans(beta_combined_model, pairwise ~ Diagnosis | object_type,
        data = beta_combined, adjust = "none", reverse = TRUE)

# Individual singlet model (fit only on singlets)
emmeans(area_alpha_1cell, pairwise ~ Diagnosis, 
        data = area_singlets, 
        adjust = "none", reverse = TRUE)

# Combined model, singlet slice
emmeans(alpha_combined_model, pairwise ~ Diagnosis | object_type, 
        data = alpha_combined, 
        adjust = "none", reverse = TRUE)

# Compare residual SDs
sigma(area_alpha_1cell)       # singlet-only residual
sigma(alpha_combined_model)   # pooled across all object types
```

# Area Plots — one cell type per chunk

Running all 4 cell types in a single chunk exhausts R's file connection limit
(~500 plots × 1 TIFF each). Splitting by cell type lets gc() reclaim handles
between chunks.

```{r plot-setup}
source("Area/R/plot_area_all_comparisons.R")

# --- Shared helpers (copied from generate_all_area_plots internals) ---
split_area_plot <- function(data, cell_col) {
  area_to_count <- c(ins_area = "Count.ins", glu_area = "Count.glu",
                     soma_area = "Count.soma", pp_area = "Count.PP")
  log_col <- paste0("log_", cell_col)
  count_col <- area_to_count[[cell_col]]
  data %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(cell_col)) & !!sym(cell_col) > 0 & !!sym(count_col) > 0) %>%
    mutate(!!log_col := log(!!sym(cell_col)))
}

add_object_type <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(object_type = factor(case_when(
    Islet.Cells == 1 ~ "Singlets",
    Islet.Cells >= 2 & Islet.Cells <= 14 ~ "SEOs",
    Islet.Cells >= 15 ~ "Islets"),
    levels = c("Singlets", "SEOs", "Islets")))
}

set_factors <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(Diagnosis = factor(Diagnosis, levels = c("ND", "T1D")),
                Region = factor(Region, levels = c("Head", "Body", "Tail")),
                Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
                Donor = factor(Donor), ImageID = factor(ImageID))
}
set_factors_t1d <- function(df) set_factors(df) %>% droplevels()

# Load subset-specific data
p_singlets     <- set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_singlets.rds"))
p_endobs       <- set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_endobs.rds"))
p_islets       <- set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_islets.rds"))
p_singlets_t1d <- set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_singlets_t1d.rds"))
p_endobs_t1d   <- set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_endobs_t1d.rds"))
p_islets_t1d   <- set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_islets_t1d.rds"))

p_beta_comb      <- add_object_type(set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_beta_combined.rds")))
p_alpha_comb     <- add_object_type(set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_alpha_combined.rds")))
p_delta_comb     <- add_object_type(set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_delta_combined.rds")))
p_pp_comb        <- add_object_type(set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_pp_combined.rds")))
p_beta_comb_t1d  <- add_object_type(set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_beta_combined_t1d.rds")))
p_alpha_comb_t1d <- add_object_type(set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_alpha_combined_t1d.rds")))
p_delta_comb_t1d <- add_object_type(set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_delta_combined_t1d.rds")))
p_pp_comb_t1d    <- add_object_type(set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_pp_combined_t1d.rds")))

model_dir  <- "Area/Models/Total_Area"
output_dir <- "Area/Graphs/total_area"

# Helper to run one cell type end-to-end
run_cell_type <- function(ct, area_col, cell_col, label, comb_diag, comb_t1d, comb_model_name, comb_t1d_name) {
  cat("\n===", toupper(label), "===\n")
  
  for (sz in list(
    list(tag = "1cell", display = "Singlets", data = split_area_plot(p_singlets, cell_col),
         model_file = paste0("area_", ct, "_1cell.rds"), has_islet = FALSE),
    list(tag = "2to14", display = "SEOs", data = split_area_plot(p_endobs, cell_col),
         model_file = paste0("area_", ct, "_2to14.rds"), has_islet = TRUE),
    list(tag = "15plus", display = "Islets", data = split_area_plot(p_islets, cell_col),
         model_file = paste0("area_", ct, "_15plus.rds"), has_islet = TRUE))) {
    cat("  Diag", sz$tag, "...\n")
    m <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, sz$model_file))
    generate_area_diag_plots(m, sz$data, paste(label, paste0("(", sz$display, ")")),
                              area_col, sz$has_islet,
                              file.path(output_dir, ct, "Diagnosis", sz$tag))
    rm(m); gc(); closeAllConnections()
  }
  
  cat("  Diag combined...\n")
  m <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, paste0(comb_model_name, ".rds")))
  generate_area_combined_diag_plots(m, split_area_plot(comb_diag, cell_col),
                                     paste(label, "(combined)"), area_col,
                                     file.path(output_dir, ct, "Diagnosis", "combined"))
  rm(m); gc(); closeAllConnections()
  
  for (sz in list(
    list(tag = "1cell", display = "Singlets", data = split_area_plot(p_singlets_t1d, cell_col),
         model_file = paste0("area_", ct, "_1cell_t1d.rds"), has_islet = FALSE),
    list(tag = "2to14", display = "SEOs", data = split_area_plot(p_endobs_t1d, cell_col),
         model_file = paste0("area_", ct, "_2to14_t1d.rds"), has_islet = TRUE),
    list(tag = "15plus", display = "Islets", data = split_area_plot(p_islets_t1d, cell_col),
         model_file = paste0("area_", ct, "_15plus_t1d.rds"), has_islet = TRUE))) {
    cat("  T1D", sz$tag, "...\n")
    m <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, sz$model_file))
    generate_area_t1d_plots(m, sz$data, paste(label, paste0("(", sz$display, ")")),
                             area_col, sz$has_islet,
                             file.path(output_dir, ct, "T1D", sz$tag))
    rm(m); gc(); closeAllConnections()
  }
  
  cat("  T1D combined...\n")
  m <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, paste0(comb_t1d_name, ".rds")))
  generate_area_combined_t1d_plots(m, split_area_plot(comb_t1d, cell_col),
                                    paste(label, "(combined)"), area_col,
                                    file.path(output_dir, ct, "T1D", "combined"))
  rm(m); gc(); closeAllConnections()
  
  cat("  ", label, "COMPLETE\n")
}
```

```{r plot-beta}
run_cell_type("beta", "ins_area", "ins_area", "\u03b2 cell area",
              p_beta_comb, p_beta_comb_t1d, "beta_combined_model", "beta_combined_t1d")
gc(); closeAllConnections()
```

```{r plot-alpha}

              p_alpha_comb, p_alpha_comb_t1d, "alpha_combined_model", "alpha_combined_t1d")
gc(); closeAllConnections()
```
